## History

Urville served as the commander of the [Astrolabe](../codex/tech.md#astrolabe), sailing in search of [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) and putting into Hobart Town two months after Dillon's departure from [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro). Throughout his career, he braved the icebergs of the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole), the coral reefs of [Oceania](../codex/places.md#oceania), and the cannibals of the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). Ultimately, he perished miserably in a railway train after surviving these many ocean hazards.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P69](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0069)_
